summary: Computes signed relative speed against a target vehicle for AI steering. When flag a4 is true it computes the longitudinal (closing) speed via a dot product of the target's position offset with a direction vector, stores the signed magnitude in this[9], and stores a normalized relative speed in this[12] (guarded against a zero-length direction). When a4 is false it computes the lateral speed via a 2D cross product and stores its signed magnitude in this[9] only.

operations.description: Branch on the a4 parameter: non-zero selects the longitudinal (dot-product) branch, zero selects the lateral (cross-product) branch. No early return; exactly one branch executes.

Longitudinal branch: read the target object pointer from this[0], then compute v5 = (targetPositionX(0x34E0) - a2[37]) * a2[41] + (targetPositionY(0x34E8) - a2[39]) * a2[43], a dot product of the target position offset with direction components a2[41]/a2[43].
Longitudinal branch: form v18 = a2[41] * v5 and v21 = a2[43] * v5, then take the square root of v21*v21 + v18*v18, negating the result when FPU condition flags C0/C3 were set.
Longitudinal branch: store the signed magnitude in this[9] (this+0x24).
Longitudinal branch: compute v11 = a2[43]*a2[43] + a2[41]*a2[41] (squared direction length).

Longitudinal branch: if v11 equals the zero threshold (flt_59E440), write this[12] = 0.0; otherwise divide (targetVelocityX(0x34F8) * a2[41] + targetVelocityY(0x3500) * a2[43]) by v11 and store in this[12] (this+0x30).
Lateral branch: compute v12 = (targetPositionY(0x34E8) - a2[39]) * a2[41] - (targetPositionX(0x34E0) - a2[37]) * a2[43], a 2D cross product of the position offset with the direction components.
Lateral branch: form v20 = -a2[43] * v12 and v22 = a2[41] * v12, take the square root of v22*v22 + v20*v20, and negate the result when FPU condition flags C0/C3 were NOT set.
Lateral branch: store the signed magnitude in this[9] (this+0x24).

unresolved: The direction components a2[41]/a2[43] and the meaning of a2[37]/a2[39] are not named in the packet; inferred as direction vector and reference position from the dot/cross structure.
The sign selection reads FPU condition-code flags (C0/C3) from a comparison the decompiler did not materialize; the exact comparison is not recovered.
field:this:0x00000000 is a pointer to the target object whose obj+0x34E0..0x3500 fields are read; the object type is not named.
